title: Book One · Chapter 26: Not Yet
story:
"Maybe I can still make your kite by Wednesday," Ronan tells Jun.

Mum is beside him. He sees her face change.

"Ronan," she says quietly. "What work is actually ready?"

"The strips."

"Are they joined?"

"No."

Jun's mother puts a hand on Jun's shoulder. "We can make something else tonight."

"But he said Wednesday," Jun says.

Jun can make something else with his mother. Ronan understands that. But he still wants Jun to wait for his kite. He wants one more day to try.

"I can try a very small one."

Leo is waiting for his father nearby. He looks down at the ground.

Miss Wu comes to the gate. She has the display list. Jun's place says PAPER KITE. The girl from the other class has left a space. She planned to put her sister's kite there.

"I need the correct list by tomorrow," Miss Wu says. "We have no new kites. I cannot put them on the list."

Jun pulls away from his mother's hand. "Then put my name down for nothing."

He walks toward the road. His mother calls him back to the gate and tells him to wait beside her. He stops beside her. He is still angry, but he stays off the road.

Ronan looks at the list. He does not want Jun's place left empty. But he has no kite to fill it.

On the way home, Mum doesn't talk at first. At the painted bird, she stops so Ronan can do up his shoe.

"Were you trying to help Jun?" she asks.

"Yes."

"Did that last answer help him choose?"

Ronan works the loose end through a knot. His fingers feel clumsy.

"No."

At home, he sits beside the board. Dad isn't there. Mum needs to deliver a finished pair of trousers. Ronan goes with her because he cannot stay alone.

The walk takes the rest of the afternoon. He carries the trousers in a clean bag. Mum checks the owner's name at the door. The woman tries the repair and pays the agreed small amount.

"That was ready," Ronan says on the way back.

"Yes."

"You said this afternoon, and it was."

"This time. Sometimes I must change a time. Then I tell people early. They need time for a new plan."

Dad comes home. Ronan asks him for one piece of plain paper. He writes Jun's name at the top. Under it, with Mum's help, he writes: I cannot make your kite for Wednesday.

He reads the sentence to Mum. "I cannot make your kite for Wednesday." The words are clear now.

He makes two more notes. Mum helps him leave them at the other families' doors that evening. They speak to one parent in person. She is annoyed. Her child waited for Ronan's kite. Her child did not choose another thing to make.

Ronan listens. He does not blame only the rain. He listens while she explains the problem.

At Jun's door, the light is on. Jun is cutting a paper wheel with his mother. There is still time to make a little windmill.

Ronan gives him the note. Jun reads slowly.

"You knew before today. I needed to know too."

"I know."

Jun doesn't invite him in. "Do you need card for the windmill?" Ronan asks. Jun's mother says they have enough.

He walks home with Mum. The bag in his hand is empty again. The families know he cannot finish. Jun has started his windmill. Ronan no longer has to promise a kite at each door.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：windmill＝风车；annoyed＝生气的；ready＝准备好的；correct＝正确的。

理解问题：

1. Ronan 继续说"再等一天"造成了什么后果？
2. 他最后怎样帮助别人重新安排？
